title: Navigate from Home to About to Projects via global header
description: Verifies users can navigate across key pages using the sticky global navigation and land on the expected pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to go to the About page
Click the navigation link to go to the Projects page
Verify the Projects dashboard primary content is displayed

title: Navigate from Projects to Contact then back Home and confirm active state updates
description: Verifies cross-page navigation works from Projects to Contact and back to Home and the active link state updates.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click the navigation link to go to the Contact page
Click the navigation link to go to the Home page
Verify the Home page hero section is displayed
Verify the Home navigation item is indicated as the active page

title: Navigation to a non-existent page shows broken or 404 state
description: Verifies attempting to navigate to a missing route results in a broken/404 state rather than expected page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link that points to a non-existent page
Verify a 404 or broken page state is shown

title: All global navigation links are present and usable from Services page
description: Verifies the global navigation is available on a secondary page and supports moving to another page.

steps.description: Navigate to /services.html
Click the navigation link to go to the Projects page
Verify the Projects dashboard primary content is displayed

title: Direct load of each primary page displays its main content
description: Verifies each static route loads and renders its primary content area to ensure navigation destinations are valid.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Navigate to /about.html
Navigate to /projects.html
Navigate to /services.html
Navigate to /contact.html
Verify the Contact page inquiry form is displayed

title: Rapid consecutive navigation clicks do not break page routing
description: Verifies quickly navigating between pages does not leave the UI in a partially loaded or incorrect state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to go to the Projects page
Click the navigation link to go to the About page
Click the navigation link to go to the Services page
Verify the Services page primary content is displayed

title: Projects search and status filter reduce results and clearing restores all
description: Verifies the client-side search and status filter work together and clearing filters restores the full project list.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Fill Metering into the projects search field
Select the Ongoing status filter
Clear all applied filters and search input
Verify all projects are displayed

title: Projects search with no matches shows empty state message
description: Verifies a no-results query shows an empty state instead of stale project cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Fill xyz-notfound into the projects search field
Verify a no-results empty state message is displayed

title: Category dropdown filter updates project cards
description: Verifies selecting a category filter updates the visible project cards without a page reload.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Select a valid category from the category dropdown
Verify the project cards update to reflect the selected category

title: Search is resilient to whitespace and case variations
description: Verifies search normalizes user input so that minor variations still return matching project cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Fill metering into the projects search field
Fill   Metering   into the projects search field
Verify project cards matching Metering are displayed

title: Open and close project details modal from the projects grid
description: Verifies that selecting a project opens a details overlay and closing it returns to the visible project grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click a project in the projects grid
Verify a project details modal overlay is displayed with project details visible
Close the project details modal
Verify the modal overlay is closed and the projects grid is visible

title: Project modal displays core fields for the selected project
description: Verifies that the modal overlay shows the expected fields (title, description, client, status) for a selected project.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click a project in the projects grid
Verify the modal shows a project title and description
Verify the modal shows a client value and a status value

title: Reopen modal after closing without losing page state
description: Verifies the user can close the modal and open another project modal without leaving the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click a project in the projects grid
Close the project details modal
Click a different project in the projects grid
Verify a project details modal overlay is displayed for the newly selected project

title: Close project modal via keyboard dismissal
description: Verifies the modal can be dismissed using keyboard input and the underlying grid remains available.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click a project in the projects grid
Press Escape
Verify the modal overlay is closed and the projects grid is visible

title: Project modal does not open when clicking outside project cards
description: Verifies that interacting with non-project areas does not incorrectly trigger the details overlay.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Click an empty area of the projects dashboard outside the projects grid items
Verify no project details modal overlay is displayed

title: Render analytics charts in the projects dashboard
description: Verifies that the doughnut and bar charts are rendered and visible in the charts area.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Scroll to the charts area
Verify a doughnut chart is displayed
Verify a bar chart is displayed

title: Show tooltip values when interacting with a chart segment
description: Verifies that interacting with a chart segment produces a tooltip with numeric information.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Scroll to the charts area
Move the pointer over a segment of the doughnut chart
Verify a chart tooltip is displayed with a numeric value

title: Charts remain visible after interacting with other dashboard components
description: Verifies that charts persist after the user interacts elsewhere on the page and returns to the charts area.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Scroll to the charts area
Scroll to the top of the projects dashboard
Scroll back to the charts area
Verify both charts are still displayed

title: Charts render responsively within the viewport
description: Verifies that the charts are not clipped and remain visible without horizontal overflow in a standard viewport.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects.html
Scroll to the charts area
Verify the full chart canvases are visible within the viewport without being cut off

title: Submit contact form with valid inputs
description: Verifies successful client-side submission behavior when all required fields are valid.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill Alice into the first name field
Fill Smith into the last name field
Fill alice.smith@example.com into the email field
Fill Partnership inquiry into the subject field
Fill I would like to discuss a potential collaboration. into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a submission confirmation UI is displayed

title: Block contact form submission when email format is invalid and subject is missing
description: Verifies inline validation appears and the form is not submitted when required fields are invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill Alice into the first name field
Fill Smith into the last name field
Fill alice.smith@ into the email field
Leave the subject field empty
Fill Testing invalid submission. into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify validation errors are displayed for the email and subject fields
Verify no submission confirmation UI is displayed

title: Show required-field validation when submitting an empty contact form
description: Verifies required field validation triggers when attempting to submit without inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Submit the contact form
Verify required-field validation errors are displayed
Verify no submission confirmation UI is displayed

title: Clear validation errors after correcting invalid contact form inputs
description: Verifies that validation messages resolve when the user fixes the invalid fields and resubmits.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill Alice into the first name field
Fill Smith into the last name field
Fill alice@ into the email field
Submit the contact form
Fill alice.smith@example.com into the email field
Fill General question into the subject field
Fill Checking that validation clears after fixing inputs. into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a submission confirmation UI is displayed

title: Mobile menu opens on mobile viewport
description: Verifies the hamburger toggle reveals the navigation links in a mobile viewport.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Click the hamburger icon
Verify the navigation links are displayed in a vertical mobile layout

title: Mobile menu closes after navigating to Contact page
description: Verifies selecting a navigation destination from the mobile menu transitions to the Contact page and closes the menu.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Click the hamburger icon
Click the navigation link to go to the Contact page
Verify the user lands on the Contact page
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed

title: Mobile menu can be toggled closed without navigation
description: Verifies the hamburger toggle closes the mobile navigation after it has been opened.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Click the hamburger icon
Click the hamburger icon again
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed

title: Mobile menu remains accessible after resizing back and forth
description: Verifies the mobile menu still opens after resizing from desktop to mobile within the same session.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a desktop width (>1024px)
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Click the hamburger icon
Verify the navigation links are displayed in a vertical mobile layout

title: Mobile menu supports keyboard activation
description: Verifies the hamburger control can be activated using the keyboard on mobile viewport.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Focus the hamburger icon
Press Enter
Verify the navigation links are displayed in a vertical mobile layout

title: Without JavaScript, hamburger toggle does not open menu
description: Verifies that when JavaScript is disabled, the hamburger toggle does not reveal mobile navigation links via the toggle interaction.

steps.description: Disable JavaScript in the browser
Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width (≤1024px)
Click the hamburger icon
Verify the mobile navigation menu does not open
